meta.description: Latest news and updates from Centrale Nantes Formula Student. Follow our journey from design to competition.
meta.ogDescription: Latest news and updates from Centrale Nantes Formula Student.

posts.title: Season 2025/2026: Official Project Kickoff
posts.excerpt: 20 students gathered for the official launch of our inaugural Formula Student season. Departments are formed, goals are set, and the countdown to competition has begun.

posts.title: Chassis Concept Design: Three Approaches Evaluated
posts.excerpt: Our chassis department has completed initial concept evaluation, comparing tubular steel, aluminium hybrid, and monocoque approaches based on weight, cost, and manufacturability.

posts.title: Sponsorship Campaign Launches for 2025/2026
posts.excerpt: Our corporate relations team has kicked off the sponsorship drive, reaching out to local and national companies. We're looking for both financial and in-kind partners.

posts.title: Motor Selection: EMRAX 228 Electric Motor Chosen
posts.excerpt: After evaluating multiple options, the powertrain department has selected a EMRAX 228 electric electric motor for our first car, balancing performance, reliability, and cost.

posts.title: Recruitment Drive: Join CNFS for 2025/2026
posts.excerpt: We're recruiting across all departments - from mechanical engineering to business and marketing. If you're a student at Centrale Nantes, there's a place for you.

posts.title: CNFS Founded: Centrale Nantes Enters Formula Student
posts.excerpt: Centrale Nantes Formula Student is officially registered as a student association. Our goal: design, build, and race a competition car within our first academic year.
